questions.questionText: Which organ pumps blood throughout the human body?
questions.explanation: The heart pumps blood throughout the body.
questions.subject: History

questions.questionText: Which gas do humans need for respiration?
questions.explanation: Humans need oxygen for cellular respiration.
questions.subject: History

questions.questionText: What is the boiling point of water at normal atmospheric pressure?
questions.explanation: Water boils at 100°C at normal atmospheric pressure.
questions.subject: History

questions.questionText: Which planet is known as the Red Planet?
questions.explanation: Mars appears reddish because of iron-rich minerals on its surface.
questions.subject: History

questions.questionText: Which vitamin is mainly produced in the skin through sunlight exposure?
questions.explanation: Sunlight helps the skin synthesize vitamin D.
questions.subject: History

questions.questionText: What force pulls objects toward the Earth?
questions.explanation: Earth's gravitational force attracts objects toward its center.
questions.subject: History

questions.questionText: Which part of a plant absorbs water and minerals from the soil?
questions.explanation: Roots absorb water and mineral nutrients from the soil.
questions.subject: History

questions.questionText: What is the chemical formula of water?
questions.explanation: A water molecule contains two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.
questions.subject: History

questions.questionText: Which blood cells help fight infections?
questions.explanation: White blood cells are important components of the immune system.
questions.subject: History

questions.questionText: Which instrument is used to measure temperature?
questions.explanation: A thermometer is used to measure temperature.
